recognize_zh: 低倍下左側為密集的淋巴組織，右側則是淡粉紅、細胞較稀疏的纖維化／水腫區，內含散在細胞；此倍率看不清腫瘤細胞形態，只能看出淋巴結結構被破壞並有硬化帶，需高倍與CD30確認ALCL。
features: Low-power field with a dense lymphoid area on the left and a pale eosinophilic, hypocellular fibrotic/edematous zone on the right
Scattered individual cells within the pale stromal zone; cytologic detail not resolvable at this magnification
Irregular interface between the cellular and sclerotic areas, indicating architectural disruption
No well-formed germinal centers identifiable in the field
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows a dense lymphoid area abutting a pale, hypocellular fibrotic to edematous zone containing scattered cells, with loss of recognizable follicular architecture in the field. Cytologic detail of the large cells is not resolvable at this magnification. The low-power appearance is nonspecific; in this case the diagnosis of ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma rests on the high-power hallmark cells and uniform strong CD30 expression.

ddx.vs: NSCHL shows broad collagen bands encircling nodules with lacunar cells that are CD15+ and weak PAX5+, whereas ALCL cells are PAX5-negative with sheets of CD30+ hallmark cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymph node with capsular/hilar fibrosis
ddx.vs: Reactive fibrosis contains no atypical large cells and preserves follicles, which requires high-power and CD30 review to exclude.
Carcinoma forms cohesive keratin-positive nests within desmoplastic stroma, whereas ALCL cells are keratin-negative and CD30-positive.
